hints.title: Monotonic Feasibility
hints.text: Notice that whether all elements can achieve at least a score X is monotonic with respect to X.

hints.title: Back and Forth Traversal
hints.text: To satisfy required visits at index i, pair round trips with the adjacent index i + 1 to accumulate score efficiently.

hints.title: Binary Search on Score
hints.text: Binary search on the minimum achievable score and verify total move constraints using greedy forward sweeps.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary searches over score space using linear greedy feasibility checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of movement choices has exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Evaluates feasibility in constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies binary search on answer coupled with adjacent round-trip move accounting.
